name: Flash Partition Planner
blurb: OTA, NVS and filesystem partitions sized, with a partition table
intro: Lays out an ESP-IDF partition table: NVS, otadata, PHY data, the app slots sized from your image plus headroom (64 KiB aligned), an optional core dump and a filesystem that takes the rest. Rules follow the ESP-IDF Partition Tables and OTA guides; the result is a partitions.csv with explicit offsets.

inputs.label: Filesystem size
inputs.help: 0 = the rest of the flash (with image-sized app slots).

examples.title: Wi-Fi sensor, 4 MB, two OTA slots and LittleFS

usage: Give chip, flash size in MB (2-32), app slots (ota2nf = ota_0+ota_1, ota2 = factory+2 OTA, ota3, factory), the app image size in KiB and headroom in %, appMode (image = image+headroom, max = split the free flash), fs (littlefs|spiffs|fat|none) with fsSize in KiB (0 = rest), NVS size in KiB, and booleans phy, nvsKeys, coredump. Returns each partition's offset and size, the app slot fill, unused flash, a partitions.csv and sdkconfig lines, and a map object with every region. Use it when starting an ESP32 project or when an OTA image no longer fits.
sources: Espressif ESP-IDF Programming Guide: Partition Tables (offsets, alignment, subtypes)
Espressif ESP-IDF Programming Guide: Over The Air Updates (otadata, ota_0/ota_1)
Espressif ESP-IDF Programming Guide: Non-Volatile Storage Library (page size, NVS encryption)
